summary: Saint Francis lived in joyful poverty and preached the Gospel through simplicity and peace. He is revered as a model of care for creation and the poor.
antiphon_text: Let us remember Saint Francis of Assisi as a faithful witness to the love and mercy of Christ.
prayer_text: Lord God, through the life of Saint Francis of Assisi, strengthen us to follow your path with courage and charity. Grant us the grace to bear faithful witness in our own time. Through Christ our Lord. Amen.
